version.changelog: After you update, run twelvetake-reaper-mcp --install-bridge. If REAPER is running the 1.7.8 bridge or later, you don't have to do anything in REAPER. If you installed with ReaPack, synchronize your packages instead. Changed: - The bridge no longer writes to REAPER's console when it starts. It wrote its version and folder there every time it started. REAPER opens the console window when a script writes to it, so the window could come up whenever the bridge started, including at launch when REAPER starts the bridge for you. To see the message, launch REAPER with REAPER_MCP_DEBUG=1 set. The console still opens when there is something you need to act on: a second copy that did not start, a request the bridge could not process, or a reload that failed. *(Reported with the fix by Kaan Özkan (@ozzaii) in issue #22.)* - test_connection.py told you to look for the start message. When the bridge does not answer, it now tells you how to run the bridge from the action list.
